newsitem.title: USA: Scientific-Atlanta in pact with Comcast.
newsitem.headline: Scientific-Atlanta in pact with Comcast.

text.p: Scientific-Atlanta Inc on Friday said Comcast Corp's Comcast Cable Communications unit has signed a letter of intent to purchase up to 300,000 home communications terminals over three years.
The non-binding letter calls for completing, within 30 days, a definitive contract and an initial purchase order for 50,000 Explorer 2000 set-top terminals from Scientific-Atlanta.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. Under the terms of the proposed contract, Scientific-Atlanta would supply up to 250,000 more Explorer 2000 set-tops.
The also said Comcast intends to purchase additional set-tops from Pioneer Electronic Corp and Toshiba Corp, who each have licensing agreements with Scientific-Atlanta.
